## AsyncOperation.kt { #asyncoperation-kt }

A future-backed operation whose callbacks stop firing once the box run that started it ends.

[`AsyncOperation`](execution.md#asyncoperation-kt-asyncoperation) wraps a `java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture` so that progress, result and error
callbacks run in the starting box's context and are suppressed after that run is stopped, re-run
or retired. Closing it cancels the source future and runs any registered cancellation hooks.

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">AsyncOperation</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> <span class="k">internal</span> <span class="k">constructor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">private</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">scope</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">RunScope</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">private</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">onResult</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">Unit</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">private</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">onError</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nc">Throwable</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">Unit</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">AutoCloseable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/runtime/lifecycle/AsyncOperation/#L30)

One asynchronous operation owned by the run that started it. [`progress`](execution.md#asyncoperation-kt--asyncoperation--progress) and the result/error callbacks run only while that run is alive, in its box context, on the completing thread. Keep these callbacks short and non-blocking. Shared clients and cached results are not owned here.
